cutoff.rule: To recover the original Epistemic-10 identity, decisive provenance evidence must immutably predate the D0 constitution cutoff.

all_required: evidence identifies one fixed exactly-ten-unit set or one fixed opaque manifest/locator root whose membership was already determined before D0
identity can be recovered without inspecting raw source semantics, truth, operator, stratum, or outcome
no selection, reselection, substitution, augmentation, or replacement occurs during recovery
recovered identity is not E1 heldout or Selected-48 transport-heldout unless pre-D0 evidence explicitly proves it was the Epistemic-10 set

NO_RECOVERABLE_ORIGINAL.effect: Original Gate2E remains non-executable under D0 because physical heldout identity is not prospectively recoverable. No scientific heldout consumption occurs.
NO_RECOVERABLE_ORIGINAL.next: A separately named D0-prime/Gate2E-prime experiment may prospectively materialize and content-address a new clean heldout, but it may not be described as the original Epistemic-10.

forbidden_evidence_or_actions: post-D0-created locator or manifest offered as proof of original identity
filesystem mtime without immutable pre-D0 authority
human recollection without immutable pre-D0 binding
browsing raw cases/corpus/source bytes to infer which ten look suitable
substituting E1 heldout or Selected-48 merely because they are available
permitted_recovery_surfaces: Git commit/ref/tag metadata and tree/path identities reachable from immutable pre-D0 history
pre-D0 Git blobs only when the path and document class are metadata/protocol/receipt/manifest/ledger and not raw case/source/truth material
GitHub Actions run/artifact metadata whose creation time predates D0, including immutable run/head/artifact names and digests
previously retained cryptographic/timestamped metadata records that themselves can be bound to a pre-D0 immutable authority

may_record: opaque locator or manifest-root identity if recovered
